subject: Post-signature orchestration: phased pilot schedule, rollback windows & training plan (Carex / ChangeWave)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@carex.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@carex.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature orchestration: pilot dates and rollback windows

Hi Evelyn / Jonas,

Thanks again for getting the contract across the line — excited to move into the implementation phase. Attached is a draft MAP and a short pilot runbook. Two quick asks to keep momentum:

1) Confirm a 2-week pilot window starting the week of Apr 23 (targeting low-risk tenant and synthetic traffic).
2) Confirm rollback windows and who owns the emergency cut (Carex vs Redwood) for the pilot.

We have procurement looped for billing / PO but want the technical schedule before they finalize timelines.

Proposed pilot plan attached: Carex_MAP_v1.xlsx, Pilot-Runbook_v0.3.pdf

Cc: Arun from ChangeWave who will be our implementation partner.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Integrations
Carex Health

--

Subject: Re: Post-signature orchestration: pilot dates and rollback windows

Liam — congrats on signing. This is a good starting point. Quick notes from our side:

- Apr 24–May 7 works for a canary-style pilot (two weeks). We'll treat Apr 24 as day 0 for config sync and smoke tests.
- Rollback policy for pilot: Redwood will run the canary switch and monitor; Carex owns traffic cutover and immediate rollback decision. We propose automated fallback to the previous model variant if latency or error rate crosses thresholds in first 2 hours.
- Owner roles: Jonas (runtime), Kimberly (CS/training), Evelyn (engagement lead).

I'll share a lightweight runbook with specific SLO thresholds and contacts by Friday morning.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Liam,

Confirming technical plan and proposing a minor tweak to reduce blast radius:

- Day -1 (Apr 23): config sync, KV priming, smoke tests on staging. No customer traffic.
- Day 0 (Apr 24): canary release to 2% of traffic for 6 hours, monitor latency/ErrorRate/2xx%.
- Day 1 (Apr 25): if metrics stable, increase to 10% for 12 hours, run acceptance evals using the shared prompt set.
- Day 3 (Apr 27): rollout to 25% if stability holds, schedule a training session for ops at 10:00 AM PT.
- Day 7: full ramp if all acceptance criteria met.

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- median token latency < 120ms at 95th percentile for legal traffic shapes
- error rate < 0.5%
- quality regression alert: eval pass rate >= 95% vs baseline

I'll draft a short failure-mode playbook (actions, who to page, DocuSign fallback) and attach.

-j

Team,

ChangeWave is aligned with the phased canary. A couple of implementation notes from our side:

- We'll provision a synthetic workload generator to replay anonymized traffic; this will run during Day 0 and Day 1 windows to speed validation.
- Training: propose 90-minute live ops workshop on Apr 27 10:00 AM PT (recorded). Kimberly — can you confirm availability?
- Migration dependency: Carex's auth token rotation must be completed by Apr 22 EOD; can you confirm the owner in your team for that task?

Arun
